title: IGNORE or DEBUG after the initial key exchange is rejected
quote: All implementations MUST understand (and ignore) this message at any time (after receiving the identification string). / All implementations MUST understand this message, but they are allowed to ignore it.
rationale: After a completed initial KEX (strict KEX overrides §11 only during the initial exchange) and ordinary traffic, IGNORE or DEBUG answered with UNIMPLEMENTED, DISCONNECT or a connection close is a violation. Unrelated asynchronous output (e.g. channel data) is not flagged.
